editorialGaps.evidence: Live chosen app index has neither postgres nor postgresql. P45's first-party Postgres descriptor is planned, not a current source item.
editorialGaps.nextAction: Owner selects a real admitted P45 database descriptor when delivered, or approves an explicitly verified existing alternative. Do not invent Postgres 17 plus nightly backups from lab copy.

editorialGaps.evidence: Exact current Registry reads for io.modelcontextprotocol/postgres and io.modelcontextprotocol/server-postgres returned HTTP 404. A broad postgres search contains unrelated third-party servers; it does not identify the lab's intended server.
editorialGaps.nextAction: Owner approves a specific verified replacement after reviewing its actual permissions, or leaves this choice absent. Supabase from the earlier lab is explicitly separate, not a relabelled generic read-only server.

editorialGaps.evidence: The lab's Postgres sentence promises nightly backups but provides no separately qualified backup item. The P45 backup recipe/Automation integration is a planned producer, not an existing curated item verified here.
editorialGaps.nextAction: Flag the job's core outcome for the owner until P45 supplies its real reviewed backup path. Reuse Happier Workflows/Automations where that owner requires them; do not add a competing workflow product or schedule in editorial data.

editorialGaps.evidence: Chrome and FFmpeg now bind to the existing happier.machine.recipes google-chrome and ffmpeg revision 1 Software choices. Python binds to the existing Mise python toolchain choice, which has no version pin. The native fonts recipe offers DejaVu, not the authored Noto Sans choice or the lab's wider bundle.
editorialGaps.nextAction: Keep Noto Sans pending until an exact offered native choice exists or the owner approves different font content. Native Software owns Machine/platform qualification and review; editorial references do not promise fleet/platform parity.

editorialGaps.evidence: font-noto-sans is a verified concrete package. The lab's all-script plus colour-emoji bundle has no admitted current offering established here.
editorialGaps.nextAction: Approve the concrete narrower font choice or bind P20's actual broader descriptor when it exists; keep unknown coverage explicit.

editorialGaps.evidence: happier.sentry is a current bundled native declaration. Canonical marketplace entries and picks are empty; no exact public npm release plus approved marketplace review was verified.
editorialGaps.nextAction: Owner approves a bundled-native management/setup choice resolved by S20's existing locator, or supplies a genuinely approved exact public listing. No plugin trust/distribution entry is fabricated.

editorialGaps.evidence: happier.channel.slack exists, but its current manifest describes Slack conversations for Happier Channels, not automatic service-outage routing.
editorialGaps.nextAction: Keep it out of this job's active picks until the owner identifies the actual supported alert path or revises its role; do not invent an integration.

editorialGaps.evidence: ntfy's catalog existence does not prove a Happier outgoing notification integration or an automatic Kuma-to-ntfy connection.
editorialGaps.nextAction: Keep the app as an independent deployable choice with honest copy; any supported connection remains its existing configuration/Action owner's work, not a job effect.
